chapter: Sue and Patsy Howard in show business
title: Musical families of Los Angeles; Nellie Lutcher
summary: Willard lists the Howard, McVea and Young families and asks about Nellie Lutcher, who lived off Central and hosted rehearsals.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So there were several musical families here in Los Angeles. There was your family, the McVey family, the Young family, where everybody was involved in music. Is that right?
Can you think of any others?
How about Nellie Latcher? When did she come to Los Angeles?
When did she come to -- Nellie Latcher?
She came to Los Angeles about -- let's see, five, six, eight or ten years ago. About ten years. She's been here a long time.
She used to live -- didn't she live right around the corner off of Central?
I think that was '42nd, I believe, she lived over on 42nd.
Yeah, it seems like something like that.

I know I talked to several musicians who said they used to go rehearse in Nellie's house and Nellie was always playing and practicing and everybody used to drop by, and there was always music going on.
Yeah, I think she lived on 42nd, if I'm not mistaken. Patty?
